name: Normal Field Supervision via Rendering and Depth Derivatives
aliases: Learnable Unit Normal with Depth Gradient Supervision
definition: The normal field $\mathcal{N}$ is supervised by enforcing consistency between rendered normal maps and the image-derivative of the depth.
summary: Normal Field Supervision via Rendering and Depth Derivatives optimizes Gaussian surface normals by enforcing consistency between rendered normals and pseudo-normals derived from depth gradients.
